title: Analysis MVP
subagentExecutionRules: Before executing any task, read this kiro.json, requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md, and all requiredSteeringContext files.
Keep edits within the task's declared ownership unless the task explicitly permits broader changes.
Use generated temporary files and test doubles for audio/probe tests; do not add real music files.
Do not implement BPM, key, section, stem, waveform, DJ strategy, playback, SQLite, mobile UI, or streaming-service functionality in this spec.
Keep ffprobe behind a subprocess adapter and make failures explicit and actionable.
After each task, update tasks.md checkboxes only for work that was completed and verified.
